# Distribution artifacts (not committed)

| Folder | Contents | Build |
|--------|----------|--------|
| `dist/dmg/` | macOS `.dmg` | `bash tool/build_dmg.sh` |
| `dist/apk/` | Android `.apk` | `bash tool/build_apk.sh` |

Filenames include the marketing version from `pubspec.yaml`
(e.g. `EastmarkHK-CRM-0.1.0-macos.dmg`).
